title: DELTASCORE: Fine-Grained Story Evaluation with Perturbations
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical aspects of story evaluation (fluency, coherence, relatedness, logicality, and interestingness) using perturbations and language models. It does not contain any component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics. While 'logicality' is an aspect, it refers to commonsense consistency within the story, not ethical or moral reasoning.
